p.s: Dear Sir or Madam,
I am writing to complain about the musical show, which gave me a very disappointing evening, while I was staying in London.
Firstly, there was a different actor instead of the famous actor, Danny Brook.
That made me so disappointed.
Secondly, I suppose the show will start at 19:30, but it started t 20:15.
It caused me missed the train and I went back to the hotel nearly in the mid-night.
Another problem is, I realised that the discounts were available.
However, there wasn't any discount.
Additionally, the advertisement said I can visit the threatre restaurant after the show.
When I arrived, it was closed.
That is so annoying that everything had been changed without any notice.
I expected to receive the money back within these two days.
Otherwise I would like to take the other action.
Your faithfully,
Silvie.
